category: cron job and background task monitoring (dead man's switch, hosted)

free_tier.stated: Hobbyist plan at USD 0 a month: 20 monitored jobs (checks) per account and 100 log entries per job; the Supporter plan at USD 5 a month has the same limits
free_tier.notes: The unit counted is the check, one per monitored job. A check is up while pings arrive within its period plus grace time and goes down, with a notification, when they stop. The Business plan (USD 20 a month, 100 jobs) is offered free of charge to open-source projects and nonprofits on request.

per_object_cap.stated: the first 100 kB of the request body of each received ping is stored; the Ping-Body-Limit response header reports the limit in bytes

retention.stated: 100 log entries are kept per job on the Hobbyist plan and the oldest entry is removed when the limit is reached; a job that pings every 5 minutes is covered for about 8 hours
retention.notes: Paid plans keep 1000 log entries per job. The API lists at most 100 logged pings for a free account.

egress.terms: not applicable: an inbound ping receiver; the ping log of a check is read back through the API, which returns 100 pings for free accounts and 1000 for paid accounts

interface_detail: Ping endpoints at hc-ping.com take HEAD, GET and POST requests with no key in the URL path beyond the check UUID or slug; a Management API v3 at healthchecks.io/api/v3 takes an X-Api-Key header with a project-specific read-write or read-only key.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client against the ping URLs and the Management API, and the web dashboard. As a last resort the server is open source under the BSD 3-clause license: the user installs and runs it on a rented or free machine.
chaining: Dead man's switch for the scheduled jobs of free hosts: a cron line, a CI schedule or a serverless timer sends one HTTP request to a ping URL, and the check alerts by email or chat when the ping stops arriving.

limits.value: 20 checks per account on the Hobbyist plan
100 log entries kept per check, oldest removed first
Management API: avoid more than 100 requests per minute; ping endpoints: a check pinged more than 5 times per minute may have requests ignored
100 kB of ping request body stored per ping

limits_note: Notification credits for SMS, WhatsApp and phone calls are listed on the Business and Business Plus plans only.
binding_note: The 20-check cap is reached before any rate limit by an account that monitors many jobs; the 5-pings-a-minute rule binds only a job that pings in a tight loop.

identity_cost.detail: The login page offers Create Your Account and states that a magic login link is emailed; payment details are entered under Account Settings, Billing, when a paid plan is chosen.

reliability_note: Pings above 5 a minute to one check are answered 200 but not recorded; an account inactive for over a year is closed 30 days after an email notice.
confidence_note: Plan limits, rate limits and the sign-up method are quoted from first-party pages. No account was opened, so whether any later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up. An authenticated API call from a free account would move the record to measured.

evidence.proved: a check goes down, with a notification, when pings stop arriving within the period plus grace time
evidence.quote: Down. The time since the last ping has exceeded Period + Grace. When a check goes from "Late" to "Down", Healthchecks.io sends you a notification.

evidence.proved: the USD 5 Supporter plan does not raise the Hobbyist limits
evidence.quote: The "Hobbyist" and "Supporter" plans have the same limits.

evidence.proved: log entries beyond the per-job limit displace the oldest ones
evidence.quote: When the limit is reached, the oldest log entries are removed to make room for new ones.

evidence.proved: 100 log entries cover about 8 hours of a job that pings every 5 minutes
evidence.quote: if the cron job runs every 5 minutes, the 100 log entries will only cover 8 hours.

evidence.proved: the Business plan is free for open-source projects and nonprofits
evidence.quote: We offer the Business plan free of charge for open-source projects and nonprofits.

evidence.proved: free accounts are limited to 20 checks
evidence.quote: For free accounts, the limit is 20 checks per account.

evidence.proved: the Management API should not be called more than 100 times a minute
evidence.quote: Avoid making more than 100 API requests per minute. If you exceed this limit, you will eventually see HTTP 429 errors.

evidence.proved: the API authenticates with an X-Api-Key header and the keys are project-specific
evidence.quote: The client can authenticate itself by including an `X-Api-Key: <your-api-key>` header in an HTTP request.

evidence.proved: the ping log returns 100 pings for free accounts and 1000 for paid accounts
evidence.quote: the total number of returned pings depends on the account's billing plan: 100 for free accounts, 1000 for paid accounts.

evidence.proved: ping endpoints take HEAD, GET and POST requests and only the first 100 kB of a ping request body is stored
evidence.quote: HEAD, GET, and POST request methods. For HTTP POST requests, clients can optionally include diagnostic information in the request body. If the request body looks like a UTF-8 string, Healthchecks.io stores the request body (limited to the first 100 kB for each received ping).

evidence.proved: a check pinged more than 5 times a minute may have requests dropped
evidence.quote: If you ping a check more than 5 times per minute, some of the requests may get rate limited and not recorded to the database.

evidence.proved: the account is created from an email address and a magic login link is emailed
evidence.quote: We will email you a magic log in link.

evidence.proved: payment details are entered in the billing settings after the account exists
evidence.quote: after register for an account on Healthchecks.io, navigate to Account Settings › Billing, select a plan, and enter your payment details.

evidence.proved: an account inactive for more than a year is closed 30 days after a notice
evidence.quote: If your Healthchecks.io account is inactive for more than a year, we send an inactive account notification to your email address. If the account is still inactive 30 days after the notification, we close your account automatically.

evidence.proved: the server software is open source under the BSD 3-clause license
evidence.quote: Healthchecks is open-source, and is licensed under the BSD 3-clause license.

notes: The free plan caps the number of jobs, not the number of pings, so a small set of frequently pinging jobs fits easily; the Business plan at USD 20 a month raises the cap to 100 jobs.
